scope: Existing application runs, full OPT1 engine plus launcher versus the preceding patched engine plus launcher; not an isolated test of PR #68 or #69.

conditions.matching: Same physical machine and same seed within each timing pair.

concentration.metric: Area-weighted absolute concentration difference summed over the assessed land cells and times, divided by the reference concentration sum, in percent.

attribution: The full package includes optimizations absent from the current two PRs, including per-worker concentration buffering. Current #69 also omits the historical hinted-search algorithm. Historical NP8 combined stack storage and slice changes; its measured single-thread whole-model effect was within timing noise. These package results cannot be assigned to either PR.
